theory.intro: Elapsed time is how much time passes between a start time and a finish time. Count on from the start, jumping to easy 'landmark' times.
facts: There are $60$ minutes in $1$ hour, so times 'roll over' at $60$, not $100$.
**Count on** in steps: first up to the next o'clock, then whole hours, then the leftover minutes.
In $24$-hour time, afternoon hours are $12$ to $23$; e.g. $2{:}30$ pm $= 14{:}30$.
steps: Write the start time and the finish time.
Count on to the next full hour, then add whole hours, then the remaining minutes.
Add the jumps together to get the elapsed time.

foundation.question_text: How much time passes from $9{:}20$ am to $10{:}05$ am?
How much time passes from $13{:}45$ to $15{:}10$?
A lesson starts at $11{:}35$ am and lasts $50$ minutes. When does it finish?
A game finishes at $4{:}15$ pm after lasting $1$ hour $30$ minutes. When did it start?
foundation.solution_text:
$4{:}15\text{ pm}-1\text{ h}=3{:}15\text{ pm}$
$3{:}15\text{ pm}-30\text{ min}=2{:}45\text{ pm}$

foundation.question_text: How much time passes from $0850$ to $1020$?
A bus leaves at $1740$ and travels for $35$ minutes. Find its arrival time.

development.question_text: How long is it from $10{:}50$ pm to $12{:}25$ am the next day?
development.solution_text:
$10{:}50\text{ pm}\to12{:}00\text{ am}=1\text{ h }10\text{ min}$
$12{:}00\text{ am}\to12{:}25\text{ am}=25\text{ min}$
$=1\text{ h }35\text{ min}$

development.question_text: A shift starts at $22{:}35$ and lasts $2$ hours $50$ minutes. When does it finish?
development.solution_text:
$22{:}35+2\text{ h}=00{:}35$
$00{:}35+50\text{ min}=01{:}25$
The shift finishes at $01{:}25$ the next day.

development.question_text: A flight lands at $0610$ after a journey of $3$ hours $45$ minutes. Find the departure time.
development.solution_text:
$0610-3\text{ h}=0310$
$0310-45\text{ min}=0225$
The departure time was $0225$.

development.question_text: Find the elapsed time from $11{:}48$ am to $2{:}17$ pm.
development.solution_text:
$11{:}48\text{ am}\to12{:}00\text{ pm}=12\text{ min}$
$12{:}00\text{ pm}\to2{:}00\text{ pm}=2\text{ h}$
$2{:}00\text{ pm}\to2{:}17\text{ pm}=17\text{ min}$
$=2\text{ h }29\text{ min}$

development.question_text: A timer started at $23{:}58$ and stopped at $00{:}13$. How long did it run?
An event ends at $15{:}05$. It lasted $2$ hours $38$ minutes. Find its start time.

mastery.question_text: A security log begins at $21{:}47$ and ends at $02{:}16$ the next day. Find the elapsed time.
A recording finished at $12{:}08$ am and lasted $2$ hours $53$ minutes. On which day and at what time did it start?
A trip starts at $18{:}55$ and lasts $6$ hours $23$ minutes. At what time does it finish?
mastery.solution_text:
$18{:}55+6\text{ h}=00{:}55$
$00{:}55+23\text{ min}=01{:}18$
The trip finishes at $01{:}18$ the next day.
